primary.platform: Web browser / Adobe Flash historical service
primary.why: Club Penguin was an online Flash MMO/social world that officially shut down in 2017, so the entry is a historical preservation record rather than a normal current play recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: No official current play route. Preserve legitimate screenshots, video captures, web archives, account memories, and source documentation; do not treat unofficial private servers as the official game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Discontinued service. Club Penguin Island and private servers are separate context, not replacements for the official original.
